summary: Retest of the 5 fixes from iteration 149. All 5 pass. Backend: test_v72d_template_criteria.py extended to 17 tests, 17/17 pass. New tests: duplicate ids return 422 and nothing is persisted; the owner can GET after submit (200, locked=true); another vendor still gets 404 after submit; owner and admin can GET after approve; PUT after approve returns 409. Regression v72/v72b/v72c: 63/64 under the default xdist config and 29/29 for v72c run serially (-n 0). The one failure is a test-ordering flake, not a product bug. The template submit gate (409 without a must-pass criterion, 200 after adding one) and the reviewer approve publish gate still hold. UI checks: (1) Vendor Tender Builder: changed Tender Name without saving, opened Criteria, added one from template and saved. The modal stayed open, the button updated to 'CRITERIA (1)' immediately, and the unsaved name 'TEST-TPLC-UI-EDITED' was still there after closing the modal. (5) AI read run twice: no exact-title duplicates (turnover from the template was skipped). Toasts said '3 new' and then '1 new'. (4) QualificationPanel (committee1, staff portal): the bid disqualified by the committee shows no q-doubt/q-score buttons, and the undecided bid still shows them.

minor.issue: pytest.ini uses '-n 2 --dist loadscope', which spreads test CLASSES across workers. TestC_AICheck::test_reviewer_runs_check depends on TestA saving criteria on VT1, so it can run first and fail with 409 'No criteria have been entered'. Passes with -n 0. Fix: make TestC seed its own criteria, or put the module in one xdist_group (--dist loadgroup).

ui_bugs.issue: Dedupe only matches exact titles. On the second AI run the LLM returned 'Methodology submission' next to the existing 'Methodology', so a near-duplicate was added. Optional: fuzzy match (e.g. one title contains the other). The AI-suggested 'Methodology' row still has no max points, so it has to be filled in before saving.

issues: Still open from earlier: raw 'rule gte 1000000 USD' and unformatted declared values ('2500000 USD') in the value column.
Still open from earlier: the header shows a raw ObjectId ('TENDER CRITERIA · 6AE6C933…') instead of the tender name.

critical_code_review_comments: In QualificationPanel, open && !b.decision also hides 'Give marks' on decided bids. That is fine because a decision is only ever 'disqualified'.
A committee 'uphold' doesn't set decision, so doubts can be raised again after an uphold. This looks intended.
